title: Anor Londo
snippet:
Anor Londo -  Dark Souls - location - plot 
 plot : Anor Londo is accessible from a yellow Resonance Ring that appears in the arena of the Iron Golem after it has been defeated. It plays an important role in gameplay, as the Lordvessel is obtained here after defeating Dragon Slayer Ornstein and Executioner Smough and reaching Gwynevere, Princess of Sunlight. Two covenants can be joined in Anor Londo.

If the player wishes to return to Sen's Fortress, they may speak to the Batwing Demon that appears where the player is placed after activating the Resonance Ring.

title: Anor Londo
snippet:
If the player is killed whilst in darkened Anor Londo, they are returned to the first bonfire regardless of whether they have rested there or not. Whether it is a glitch or an intended function by the developers is unconfirmed.

If the player desires to fight Dark Sun Gwyndolin via an easy return to the boss area, it is preferable to either:
Leave Gwynevere alive so as to not make Anor Londo dark, and then fight Gwyndolin. This allows the player to respawn at the Darkmoon Tomb bonfire.
After killing Gwynevere, ignore the Darkmoon Knightess (so as not to kill her in combat) to keep the first Bonfire lit so that the player may warp to the Darkmoon Tomb after death.

If the player has already darkened Anor Londo and killed the Darkmoon Knightess, the fastest method will be to run to the entrance way of The Duke's Archives (only accessible after placing the Lordvessel) and using the bonfire by the elevator to warp.

title: Anor Londo (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
Anor Londo (Dark Souls III) -  Dark Souls III - location - description 
 description : Unlike its Dark Souls counterpart, Anor Londo's illusionary shining sun is gone and has been replaced with the cold blue rays of the moon. The city has noticeably frozen over, as well as being severely reduced in size, with the only remaining parts of the old city being the cathedral, the rotating staircase, and the honorary tomb of Gwyn. An additional tower now stands where the entrance of the building housing the Painted World of Ariamis once stood, with an invisible walkway leading to the top. Additionally, only three of the Silver Knights remain and all Batwing Demons are gone. The cathedral has been overrun by Deacons of the Cathedral of the Deep and Writhing Rotten Flesh. The inside of the cathedral has been covered in corpses and maggots. The eastern section of the cathedral has been blocked off by debris, but the western section is still accessible and contains the body of an old blacksmith.

snippet: Once in Anor Londo, the player makes their way into the Anor Londo cathedral, where they face Dragonslayer Ornstein, of the Four Knights of Gwyn, and Executioner Smough. title: Ashen One
snippet:
Ashen One -  Dark Souls III - character - irithyll_and_anor_londo_dark_souls_iii_anor_londo 
 irithyll_and_anor_londo_dark_souls_iii_anor_londo : On the surface, the Ashen One fights their way to the grand church in Irithyll where they find Pontiff Sulyvahn. Killing Sulyvahn opens the way to Anor Londo, fabled city of the gods, where Aldrich awaits. Aldrich, having lost interest in the flame and having instead turned towards the Dark, sought out Anor Londo to devour the gods themselves. He found and devoured Dark Sun Gwyndolin in Anor Londo, who had been "stricken by illness" and had retreated to the Anor Londo Cathedral, only to be imprisoned by the Pontiff to be fed to Aldrich. Fighting their way past the archers protecting the city, the Ashen One finds Aldrich using Gwyndolin as a puppet of sorts, and kills him, acquiring his ashes to be delivered to his throne.

title: Gwynevere, Princess of Sunlight
snippet:
Gwynevere, Princess of Sunlight -  Dark Souls III - character - plot 
 plot : Upon meeting with Gwynevere for the first time, she grants the player the Lordvessel, which enables the ability to warp between most bonfires. Gwynevere can also initiate players into the Princess's Guard covenant.

Killing Gwynevere, which requires a single hit with any attack, will reveal that she is an illusion created by Gwyndolin. Gwyndolin then removes the rest of his enchantment, causing the sun to permanently set in Anor Londo. In addition, any player that darkens Anor Londo will become more susceptible to Blade of the Darkmoon invasions when human. All deaths within Anor Londo will return the player to the first Bonfire in Anor Londo by the Darkmoon Knightess, regardless of the last bonfire used. In addition, all regular enemies will vanish, except Painting Guardians, a few Silver Knights and two new hostile characters.

title: Darkmoon Knightess
snippet:
Darkmoon Knightess -  Dark Souls - character - plot 
 plot : The Darkmoon Knightess is one of Dark Sun Gwyndolin's loyal followers and the fire keeper of the first bonfire in Anor Londo. As with the other fire keepers, the Darkmoon Knightess can upgrade Estus Flasks using Fire Keeper Souls. Like all other fire keepers, killing the Darkmoon Knightess will cause the fire she watches over to be extinguished, although players can still warp to it after obtaining the Lordvessel.

Should the player kill Gwynevere, the Darkmoon Knightess will appear directly in front of the elevator of Anor Londo to offer punishment for the deed. Should the player attack Dark Sun Gwyndolin, the Darkmoon Knightess will also become hostile and reside in her usual location, the first Anor Londo bonfire. Her armor, the Brass Set can be found in the room with the sunlight blade miracle after defeating Dark Sun Gwyndolin.

title: New Londo Ruins
snippet:
New Londo Ruins -  Dark Souls - location - dark_souls 
 dark_souls : {'name': 'Theories', 'description': 'The numerous female statues accompanying a child present in New Londo may represent the advent of the Dark Lord awaited by humanity, as opposed to the statues present at the Undead Burg, Undead Parish and Firelink Shrine which awaited a Chosen Undead who would have brought him back to the splendor of the Age of Fire. Unlike the statues outside the city, those in New Londo represent the child standing on their legs instead of being held in the lap of the female figure, who only accompanies them.\nAdditionally the female figure may represent Velka, Goddess of Sin as New Londo was a city of humans whose sins and salvation were her responsibility to administer, and the same statue can be found in the Painted World of Ariamis, where multiple artifacts affiliated with Velka or considered heretical, like the potential message about the coming of the Dark Lord, can be found'}

title: Deep Accursed
snippet: The Deep Accursed in Anor Londo is visible on the ceiling in the grand hall and will drop down when the player tries to reach the switch to open the main doors. The pillars can be used as cover. However, a safer strategy is to retreat up one of the staircases and slay it from a distance. Whilst the beast cannot reach the player, it will frequently jump into the air to reposition itself, and can cause damage if the player is too close. If the player remains out of its sight long enough, the monster may calm down again, allowing them to resume the fight with a plunging attack.

title: Anri of Astora
snippet: After defeating the Abyss Watchers and gaining access to the Catacombs of Carthus, the player can find Anri within the area, alone and distraught from being separated from Horace. The player can help them reunite by locating Horace, and Anri will lay Prism Stones to guide Horace to their reunion. However, unbeknownst to both Anri and the Ashen One, Horace has hollowed within the Smouldering Lake and the quest can either end or continue in one of three ways, once the player has encountered Horace at Smouldering Lake and then found Anri near the rope bridge in Carthus:

title: Ending (Dark Souls III)
snippet:
** If the player finds but does not kill Horace, then proceeds to tell Anri where he is, Anri will seek him out but be killed by the hollowed Horace, prematurely and voiding this ending.
At this point, it is best to ensure that the player has talked to Yuria of Londor at least once and exhausted her dialogue, where she will inform the player of an upcoming wedding ceremony between the Ashen One and Anri.
Talk to Anri in the Church of Yorshka bonfire in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley. Be sure to exhaust their dialogue, receiving the "Quiet resolve" gesture.
** the Old Woman of Londor, disguised as a statue in a corner of the room. It is better to avoid interacting with her entirely.
Defeat Pontiff Sulyvahn and return to Firelink Shrine. Exhaust Yuria's dialogue to confirm that Anri awaits the player within Darkmoon Tomb.

title: Berenike Knight
snippet: As the First Flame began to fade, countless among the ranks of the Berenike Knights became Undead and ventured to Lordran. Here they tried to make their way toward Anor Londo through the only possible access: Sen's Fortress. The knights of Berenike and Tarkus thus entered the dangerous proving ground; after decades of struggling to advance, much of the Knights ended up as Hollows, becoming a threat to the other Undead in the location. Tarkus, probably accompanied by some fellow knights, eventually reached the peak of Sen's Fortress and challenged the last trial in the form of the Iron Golem. The mighty knight in black iron armor managed to defeat the guardian of Anor Londo, gaining access to the city of the gods. However, after reaching Anor Londo, Tarkus perished at the hands of the Painting Guardians before he could reach Gwynevere and obtain the Lordvessel. The few Berenike Knights that followed him to Anor Londo ended up inside the Painted World of Ariamis.

snippet:

title: Lord Gwyn's Firstborn
snippet: Given how the firstborn only had respect for arms, it's possible that he chose to ally with the dragons, hence why the Gods would expunge him from history. It is known that the firstborn left the Sunlight Blade Miracle on Gwyn's honorary tomb in Anor Londo as a final farewell, which could only mean that Gwyn had already departed for the Kiln of the First Flame.

snippet:
Silver Knight -  Dark Souls - enemy - general_information 
 general_information : Silver Knights are a primary enemy in Anor Londo. They have high lightning resistance and their armor offers a small Curse resistance.

They wear the Silver Knight Set, use a Silver Knight Shield and wield either a Silver Knight Straight Sword, Silver Knight Spear, or Dragonslayer Greatbow. When faced at short range, the Dragonslayer Greatbowmen can switch to a sword and shield.

Silver Knights are able to backstab the player.

Silver Knights will still appear even if Anor Londo goes Dark, they are one of the respawnable enemies as well as the Painting Guardians.

title: Silver Knight Armor
snippet:
Silver Knight Armor -  Dark Souls - armor - description 
 description : Armor of the Silver Knights who protect Anor Londo.

When Lord Gwyn departed to link the Fire, his knights split into two groups. The Silver Knights remained in the forsaken capital in the service of their goddess.
